A [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] '''clan''' operated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]], amassing significant power and [[Currency/Legends|fortune]]. The [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Pekt]] was a prominent member of the clan, known for his sadistic treatment of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] prior to the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]].

==Description==
A [[Currency/Legends|wealthy]] and powerful [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] clan operated an empire on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. The clan employed servants and participated in the Trandoshan's ancient rivalry with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of Trandosha's neighboring planet&mdash;[[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]&mdash;keeping Wookiee [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] in a [[Pekt's clan's garrison|garrison]].<ref name="GB" />

==History==
[[File:PektGB.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Pekt expanded the clan's empire by enslaving Wookiees.]]
One wealthy [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pekt's father|member]] of the clan [[Parent/Legends|fathered]] the sadistic [[Pekt]], who became legendary among his people for escalating the conflict against the Wookiees and expanding the clan's empire. As a [[Youngling/Legends|hatchling]], Pekt experimentally [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] his families' servants with [[Shock collar/Legends|slave collars]] and restraints. In adolescence, he experimented on the clan's Wookiee prisoners, eventually using his father's fortune to study their biology and develop restraints and techniques to efficiently capture and [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] them.<ref name="GB" />

Pekt developed a reputation for his ability to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Wookiees, partnering with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during their failed [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] and [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] against the Wookiees on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]],<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Pekt was also hired by the Trandoshan [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to create several customized weapons, for which he received several fine Wookiee [[Hair/Legends|pelts]] that he passed on to his [[Egg/Legends|egg]] litter. After the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Pekt was hired by Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Hindane Darcc]] to oversee the slaving operations on Kashyyyk throughout the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. The Trandoshan was ultimately killed on the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]]&mdash;which he had designed&mdash;in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the planet by forces led by the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] during the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pekt first appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', which included a DataBank entry on the character that mentioned his clan.<ref name="GB" />
